statistics_frozen.validation_budget: 12 mu grid points x 20 disjoint validation seeds = 240 episodes per arm per cell; floor, matched oracle, and every injected arm measured on the IDENTICAL episode set (paired)
statistics_frozen.floor_definition: floor = the better (validation success; selection chooses configs, validation picks the max) of {best-selection seeker over the frozen M3215 per-cell tau grid x rates {2000,6000,20000} x backoffs {0.06,0.15} x dv {0,0.75}, best-selection fixed plan over 8 fixed speeds + 3 fixed ramps}; includes the familiarization prefix + vehicle-RLS fixture
statistics_frozen.oracle_definition: matched per-mu oracle on the same degraded cell and same episodes, per-point dv selected on subst_sel from {-0.5, 0, +0.5, +1.0}
statistics_frozen.prize: prize = oracle_val - floor_val (re-measured, episode-paired); Newcombe 95% CI reported; recapture denominator requires prize > 0
statistics_frozen.per_episode_difference: D_e = mean over 8 training seeds of arm success on episode e minus floor success on episode e; Delta = mean_e D_e; recapture = Delta / prize
statistics_frozen.uncertainty: two-way SE in quadrature: SE_ep = sd(D_e)/sqrt(240) (episode level, pairing retained) + SE_seed = sd over the 8 per-seed Delta_s / sqrt(8) (training-seed cluster); one-sided 97.5% lower bound = Delta - 1.959964 * sqrt(SE_ep^2 + SE_seed^2); a pure 8-cluster seed SE would share episodes across clusters and underestimate episode noise, hence the quadrature form (frozen)
statistics_frozen.cell_pass: recapture >= 0.5 AND one-sided 97.5% lower bound > 0 AND prize > 0
statistics_frozen.cross_cell_aggregate: pooled fraction = sum over cells of sum_e D_e / sum over cells of sum_e (O_e - F_e), reported descriptively only; per-cell fractions descriptive

primary_frozen.rule: PRIMARY PASS iff L3_GRU achieves cell_pass in >= 3 of the 4 eligible cells
primary_frozen.exploratory: L0/L2 arms, the C3 block, the L4 block, pooled fractions, and all diagnostics are reported, never gated

c3_frozen.purpose: C3 (FIR vs IIR, M1182): excitation-to-decision gap >> max FIR window (2 s) + max delay (0.5 s); only state-bearing estimators can carry mu across the gap
c3_frozen.floor: best of {no-belief handover, constant-mu handover 0.45 / 0.70 / 0.95} selected on subst_sel, validated on subst_val (constant-mu arms are belief-free fixed plans in belief space)
c3_frozen.conditional_readout: the L3 vs L2_100 comparison is reported per cell ONLY IF at least one history arm (L2_25/L2_50/L2_100/L3_GRU) clears the C3 floor (one-sided 97.5% lower bound of arm - floor > 0, same two-way SE)
c3_frozen.tost: equivalence bound |Delta| < 0.05 with the 90% CI (two-way SE) inside the bounds -> FIR_sufficient
c3_frozen.verdict: per qualifying cell: iir_wins if one-sided 97.5% lower bound of (L3 - L2_100) > 0; else fir_sufficient if TOST passes; else indeterminate; non-qualifying cells report not_reported_no_history_arm_clears_floor

outcome_routes_frozen: PRIMARY PASS -> G-B passes, WP2 proceeds
all arms fail (primary FAIL and no exploratory arm cell_pass) -> ONE bounded excitation/representation iteration (<= 1 week, <= 4 h CPU), then accept the bound as the result
primary FAIL but some exploratory arm passes -> report descriptively, no best-arm inference, G-B adjudicates on the primary as written
L0_frame achieves cell_pass in >= 3 cells -> leak audit, <= 1 redesign round, then report the leak itself as a finding and scope claims down
re-measured prize <= 0 in a cell -> that cell cannot pass (recapture undefined); reported as construction-degenerate
dataset leak gate fails -> run stops before training; one bounded data iteration, then accept
C3 telemetry gate fails -> C3 readout invalid and reported; standard block unaffected
